inj.note: Mahomes returned to Sunday's win after hurting his elbow late in the first half, and the initial MRI result offers some early optimism regarding the star quarterback's status for Week 10 against the Falcons. His participation level in practice will bear monitoring over the coming days, but all signs point to Mahomes having avoided a significant injury.

news.h: Kenneth Walker III comes up huge in Week 9 win
news.d: Report on how Kenneth Walker III helped the Chiefs in Week 9 after Patrick Mahomes' injury.

news.h: Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes brushes off injury scare during rout of Jets
news.d: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes was able to play through pain in his right arm after absorbing a massive hit during Sunday's 35-12 victory over the Jets.

news.h: Kenneth Walker scores 3 TDs as the Chiefs roll past the woeful Jets 35-12 to end their 2-game skid
news.d: — Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes walked off the field dangling his right arm, which had been bent grotesquely on a strip-sack by the Jets' David Bailey, and for the briefest of moments a pall seemed to descend over Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday.

news.h: Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes hasn't run QB sneak since '19 season
news.d: The Chiefs continue to struggle in short-yardage rushing situations, with the team having not attempted a sneak of any kind since the 2023 season.

news.h: Kansas City Chiefs' late collapse vs. Denver Broncos opens up AFC West race
news.d: Prior to Sunday's game, the Chiefs were 80-2 when leading by 10 or more in the fourth quarter under Patrick Mahomes.
